artmind domains harmonize.extra: Use --dry-run to preview changes; never removes child-specific extras.

examples:
artmind ingest pull-kg \
  --repo git@github.com:acme/kg-store.git \
  --repo-path data/kg/sales_collateral \
  --domain sales_collateral
artmind ingest detect-conflicts --domain A --domain B --dry-run --output conflicts.json
artmind ingest detect-conflicts --domain A --domain B --from-file conflicts.json
artmind query vector-text "interest rate changes" --domain banking --topK 10
artmind query graph text2cypher "Which entities are connected to Acme Corp?" --domain banking
